name: euclidean_plane
description: Tarski-style Euclidean plane geometry axioms, organized by logical dependency layers
author: Lv-00 Core Team

layers.name: incidence

axioms.name: Two-Point Incidence
axioms.signature: forall (A B : Point), A != B -> exists! (l : Line), on(A, l) /\ on(B, l)

axioms.name: Line Points Existence
axioms.signature: forall (l : Line), exists (A B : Point), A != B /\ on(A, l) /\ on(B, l)

axioms.name: Non-Collinearity
axioms.signature: exists (A B C : Point), ~(exists (l : Line), on(A, l) /\ on(B, l) /\ on(C, l))

layers.minimal_model: 3-point projective plane (Fano plane fails I1 interpretation)
layers.independence_notes: I1, I2, I3 are pairwise independent

layers.name: order
layers.description: Betweenness relations governing point ordering on lines

axioms.name: Betweenness Symmetry
axioms.signature: forall (A B C : Point), B(A, B, C) -> B(C, B, A)

axioms.name: Betweenness Extension
axioms.signature: forall (A B : Point), A != B -> exists (C : Point), B(A, B, C)

axioms.name: Betweenness Uniqueness
axioms.signature: forall (A B C : Point), B(A, B, C) -> ~B(B, A, C) /\ ~B(A, C, B)

axioms.name: Pasch Axiom
axioms.signature: forall (A B C P Q : Point), ~collinear(A, B, C) /\ B(A, P, B) -> (B(C, Q, A) \/ B(B, Q, C))

layers.minimal_model: Dense linear order without endpoints (applied to lines)

layers.name: congruence
layers.description: Segment congruence relations for metric comparison

axioms.name: Segment Construction
axioms.signature: forall (A B C D : Point), A != B -> exists! (E : Point), (B(C, D, E) \/ B(C, E, D)) /\ AB =~= CE

axioms.name: Congruence Transitivity
axioms.signature: forall (A B C D E F : Point), AB =~= CD /\ AB =~= EF -> CD =~= EF

axioms.name: Segment Addition
axioms.signature: forall (A B C A' B' C' : Point), B(A, B, C) /\ B(A', B', C') /\ AB =~= A'B' /\ BC =~= B'C' -> AC =~= A'C'

layers.minimal_model: Rational plane Q^2 (satisfies C1-C3 but not continuity)
layers.independence_notes: C3 is independent of C1 and C2. Five-Segment Axiom (implied) provides angle congruence.

extended_axioms.name: Five-Segment Axiom
extended_axioms.note: Implied by the geometry; used to derive angle congruence without explicit angle primitives

layers.name: continuity

axioms.name: Dedekind Cut Axiom
axioms.signature: forall (l : Line) (P Q : Point -> Prop), partition(l, P, Q) /\ (exists X, P(X)) /\ (exists Y, Q(Y)) -> exists Z, cut_point(l, P, Q, Z)

layers.independence_notes: Independent of layers 0-2. Rational plane model satisfies 0-2 but not continuity.

layers.name: parallels

axioms.name: Playfair Parallel Axiom
axioms.signature: forall (A : Point) (l : Line), ~on(A, l) -> exists! (m : Line), on(A, m) /\ ~intersect(l, m)

layers.independence_notes: Independent of layers 0-3. Hyperbolic geometry satisfies 0-3 but not Playfair.
equivalents: Wallis's axiom (existence of similar triangles of arbitrary size)

references: Tarski, A. 'What is Elementary Geometry?' In The Axiomatic Method (1959), pp. 16-29. North-Holland.
Schwabhauser, W., Szmielew, W., & Tarski, A. Metamathematische Methoden in der Geometrie (1983). Springer.
Hilbert, D. Grundlagen der Geometrie (1899). Teubner.
